svg.title: How long one signature takes
svg.desc: Median signing time on the author's machine, logarithmic scale: ECDSA and Ed25519 about 0.03 ms; UOV about 0.03 ms; MAYO and Falcon 0.1 to 0.3 ms; ML-DSA 0.07 to 0.9 ms depending on implementation; RSA 0.3 ms; MQOM 2 ms; SLH-DSA-128f 25 ms; SLH-DSA-128s 530 ms. A server signs once per handshake; a CA and a log once per certificate.

text.tspan: ML-DSA through liboqs; through OpenSSL it measured up to 7x slower here
